title: RADIO FM-CAPACITORS
summary: RPO U69 AM/FM radio noise-suppression capacitors in the engine compartment: one at the heater blower motor (connects into the orange-wire motor connector and grounds at the blower ground terminal under the production motor screw, 10-15 LBS IN), and one on the ignition coil, screwed to the coil bracket (15-22 LBS IN) with its lead on the coil positive (+) terminal under the production coil nut.

parts.name: CAPACITOR ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Capacitor assembly – heater blower motor radio suppression

parts.name: CAPACITOR ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Capacitor assembly – ignition coil radio suppression

fastening.note: Capacitor [1] plugs in line at the blower motor connector (orange wire); its ground lead goes to the blower ground terminal, held under the production MOTOR screw (triangle 1, 10-15 LBS IN). The ground connector (black wires) joins there too. No separate fastener callout.
Screw [2] goes through the mounting tab of capacitor [3] into the coil mounting bracket.
Capacitor [3] lead ring terminal goes on the coil (+) terminal stud under the production COIL nut.
